summary: Frontend-only UI/integration testing of new /dashboard/overview page, ReferralCard, PickupTimeline, Activity-tab removal and Pickup Details section reorder. 46/47 spec items verified PASS via Playwright at the production preview URL. ONE real functional bug found: BC-7984 (completed pickup) renders the final 'Recycled' timeline step with data-state='current' instead of 'done' — spec explicitly requires all 5 steps in 'done' state for a completed pickup. Root cause: mockPickups.js getPickupTimeline() uses currentIdx=4 for status='completed' and marks index===currentIdx as 'current', so it pulses the Recycled dot on already-completed pickups. Everything else (redirect, sidebar Overview link active, stats values, upcoming list, recent activity (6 items including coupon usage), referral code AANYA100 + Copy state + Share clipboard fallback + 3 friends / ₹300 earned, 4 quick-actions with first having terracotta accent + correct hrefs, Activity tab removed + ?tab=activity fallback to profile, BC-8307 5-step timeline with in_progress=current and completed=upcoming, BC-7321 cancelled timeline with exactly 2 steps incl. cancelled state, section reorder 01 Tracking → 02 Schedule → 03 Notes → 04 Pictures → 05 Impact, 2-col stat grid at 375px) all verified passing.

ui_bugs.issue: Completed pickup (e.g. BC-7984) renders the last step 'Recycled' with data-state='current' (pulsing terracotta dot) instead of 'done'. Spec: 'completed pickup timeline shows all 5 steps as done.' Fix: when pickup.status === 'completed', mark every step (including 'completed' / Recycled) as 'done', not 'current'. Easy patch in getPickupTimeline: special-case status === 'completed' to map all 5 steps to {state:'done'}.

action_items: Fix getPickupTimeline() in /app/frontend/src/lib/mockPickups.js so that pickup.status === 'completed' yields ALL 5 steps with state='done' (including the final 'Recycled' step). Currently the last step is 'current' which keeps a pulsing terracotta ring on already-finished pickups and contradicts the spec checklist item: '/dashboard/pickups/BC-7984 (completed pickup) timeline shows all 5 steps as done.'
critical_code_review_comments: mockPickups.js getPickupTimeline: idxByStatus.completed = 4 plus the 'i === currentIdx → current' rule makes the terminal state visually unfinished. Either bump currentIdx to 5 for completed (so every step becomes 'done') or add an explicit if (pickup.status === 'completed') return all.map(s => ({...s, state:'done'})) branch — symmetrical to the cancelled branch.
DashboardOverview.jsx ActivityFeed renders React elements (JSX with <span>) into the it.title field. This is fine in React but blocks any future SSR/text extraction. Acceptable for now.

ReferralCard share() swallows ALL errors silently (catch {}). If navigator.clipboard.writeText fails in the fallback branch the user gets no feedback. Consider toast.error in catch when typeof navigator.share !== 'function' and clipboard also throws.

DashboardOverview.jsx imports both savedAddresses & timeSlots from '@/lib/mockData' just to resolve label/range strings for each pickup row. A small helper getPickupAddressLabel(pickup) in mockPickups.js would centralise this — same lookup repeats in PickupRow, ActivityFeed and PickupDetails.
PickupTimeline.jsx 'animate-pulse' is on the ring span (correct), terracotta #C45B38 dot for current — verified visible in BC-8307 screenshot. Good.

Sidebar 'Overview' uses NavLink with end:false; URLs like /dashboard/overview/anything would also mark it active. Currently no nested routes exist so it's fine, but if sub-pages get added consider end:true.

rca_of_the_issue: /app/frontend/src/lib/mockPickups.js getPickupTimeline() maps pickup.status='completed' to currentIdx=4 (the 'completed'/Recycled step). The subsequent map applies 'i < currentIdx → done', 'i === currentIdx → current', 'i > currentIdx → upcoming'. For a completed pickup currentIdx=4 == last index, so steps 0..3 become 'done' and step 4 becomes 'current' (with animate-pulse ring). Spec requires the entire timeline to be 'done' once the pickup is completed. Fix options: (a) add a short-circuit branch `if (pickup.status === 'completed') return all.map(s => ({...s, state:'done'}));` mirroring the cancelled branch, or (b) set idxByStatus.completed = 5 so currentIdx > last index and every step falls under the 'i < currentIdx' done branch. Reproduction: navigate to /dashboard/pickups/BC-7984 and inspect [data-testid='timeline-step-completed'] — data-state attribute will read 'current' instead of 'done'. Visual symptom: a pulsing terracotta ring on the Recycled dot even though the pickup is finished and the header chip says COMPLETED.
